CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

2. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

6. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

10. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

11. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   B. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   D. Damage equipment used for Photography.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
